name: François Bourdin
description: François Bourdin is a French concept artist and illustrator known for his emotionally rich pencil drawings inspired by music, cinema, and literature. Based in Nantes, France, Bourdin works as a freelance concept artist and character designer for video games and animated films. His artistic style blends graphical finesse with poetic charm , often evoking a sense of nostalgia and dreamlike emotion. His portfolio features over 170 artworks, showcasing a wide range of characters and scenes that reflect his cinematic and musical influences. Bourdin’s illustrations are available on platforms like ArtStation and Troublanc, where his work is celebrated for its expressive detail and imaginative storytelling . Whether sketching a sleeping city or a vibrant character, his creations invite viewers into a world shaped by rhythm, mood, and visual poetry.
